fields.Calculation:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-16"?><CalculationBase xmlns:i="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" i:type="XScriptExpressionCalculation" xmlns="http://schemas.intelex.net"><Expression>IF(EntryType.Value = "PERIOD", 

	IF (AND(To <> NULL, From <> NULL),
		DATEDIFF("d", From, To) + 1
	, 
		0
	)
,
	IF(EntryType.Value = "DURATION", 
		Duration
	,
		IF(EntryType.Value = "DAY", 
			1
		,
			NULL
		)	
	)
)</Expression></CalculationBase>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-16"?><CalculationBase xmlns:i="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" i:type="XScriptExpressionCalculation" xmlns="http://schemas.intelex.net"><Expression>IF(
	OR(
		InjOutcomeHelp = "Days Away From Work",
		InjOutcomeHelp = "Job Transfer or Restriction"

, 
	SUM(
		SUM(Days.RestrictedDays), 
		SUM(Days.JobTransfer) 
	) 
,

)
</Expression></CalculationBase>

Hours and Headcount should be added or assigned at the location where the Hours and Headcount actually occurred. Hours and Headcount for child locations will roll up to the parent locations. For example: if your company has five locations in a region or a country you would want to enter the Hours and Headcount at the five individual locations and not at the region or country. The Hours and Headcount from the five individual locations will roll up to and populate the parent region or country Hours and Headcount.

data.Description:
Using the "[SM-OSHA] 05 - Rollup Data Import (1/2)" as all the rollup locations that need to be updated. This report combines the data from the "[SM-OSHA] 03 - Rollup Recordable Data" and "[SM-OSHA] 04 - Hours and Headcount (3/3)" reports into a single report.
There is no filter on this report because the amount of data is controlled by "[SM-OSHA] 05 - Location Data Import"

data.Description:
Initialize 'OSHA Summary' records for all locations for the current and past year.
This report is also filtered to only create OSHA Summaries when one does not exist.
As well as, if a location has been modified within the last 36 hours. This filter was implemented to update the location data if it is changed (eg. Sate/Province, City, etc.)
